name: Schedule status and timeline
summary: The schedule timeline view, and the status each planned item gets from planned dates against measured progress.

roles.note: The seed catalog has no schedule-specific permission strings. Who may upload or edit schedules is unknown (DEC-010 covers related edit rights).

actions.note: Assumed to follow progress viewing; not confirmed

nfr.statement: Time to render the schedule timeline for a whole project.
nfr.open_question: What p95 is acceptable for the timeline on the largest projects?

requirements.title: Which schedule status wins
requirements.statement: An item is checked in this order: - Complete, if measured progress has reached takeoff - with no planned dates: "No schedule dates" if there is progress, else "Not started" - with no progress: "Not started" before the planned start, "No progress data" after it - Overdue, only after all of these, when the planned finish has passed

acceptance_criteria.given: An item whose planned finish passed a week ago, with no progress recorded
acceptance_criteria.then: (Current behaviour) It is "No progress data", not Overdue

requirements.title: On track within 5 points of where the plan says today
requirements.statement: Inside its planned window with some progress, an item's expected percentage is the share of the window that has passed. If actual minus expected is above 0 it is Ahead; from 0 down to -5 it is On track; below -5 it is Behind. Without takeoff the backend says On track. This tolerance differs from the 15-point alert rule (PROG-REQ-040).

acceptance_criteria.given: An item halfway through its window, at 45% complete
acceptance_criteria.then: It is On track, because exactly -5 counts as On track

requirements.title: Schedule working days skip weekends only
requirements.statement: The schedule counts working days by skipping Saturdays and Sundays in UTC. It ignores holidays and the project's time zone, unlike the forecast's working-day count (PROG-REQ-032).

acceptance_criteria.given: A range from Monday to the following Monday, with a public holiday on Wednesday
acceptance_criteria.then: The count is 6 (the holiday is counted)

requirements.title: The web app relabels schedule statuses
requirements.statement: The web timeline doesn't show the backend's label as-is: - Overdue becomes Late - Not started and No progress data become Late after the finish date, otherwise NA - items without takeoff become Late or In progress - "No schedule dates" becomes Complete only with takeoff and 100% or more "Today" is the browser's day, not the project's.
open_checks: Check no work, missing dates, zero denominators and the planned-finish boundary in every view and export

acceptance_criteria.given: The backend returns Overdue for an item

requirements.title: Schedule timeline view
requirements.statement: A timeline view shows the project schedule visually, with each item's status.
open_checks: The demo session had no access to Schedule

acceptance_criteria.given: A project with an imported schedule
acceptance_criteria.when: A user opens the timeline view
acceptance_criteria.then: They see each planned item as a bar over time
